subject: Request: Private/on-prem demo and compliance scope for Novacare
messages:
From: Emma Lau <emma.lau@novacare.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Private/on-prem demo and compliance scope for Novacare

Hi Jordan,

I signed up via the self-serve page this morning and selected "On-prem / VPC" as our preferred deployment. We're evaluating Redwood for a HIPAA-scoped deployment across several hospitals and would like a demo focused on on-prem installation, tenant isolation, and audit logs.

Our initial ask:
- 45 minute technical demo (ops + security)
- Proof points for SOC2 / audit logging and KMS integration
- High-level install footprint and networking requirements

I've attached our preliminary security questionnaire (answers not required yet) and added procurement on cc.

Preferred times (PST) this week: Tue 6/8 10:00-12:00, Wed 6/9 14:00-16:00.

Thanks,

Emma Lau
IT Security Lead
Novacare Healthcare
emma.lau@novacare.io
Attachments: novacare-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)
Cc: procurement@novacare.io

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-07T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Private/on-prem demo and compliance scope for Novacare

Hi Emma —

Thanks for signing up and for the clear details. I'm Jordan on the Redwood Sales Engineering team; I'd be happy to run the demo and invite one of our Solutions Engineers to cover the deployment specifics.

I have the following options available (PST):
- Tue 6/8 10:30-11:15
- Wed 6/9 14:00-14:45
- Thu 6/10 09:00-09:45

Please pick any slot or share an alternative. If you can, please complete the short intake form here so we can tailor the demo: https://redwood.ai/s/priv-intake-novacare (simple one-page). I'll also attach our on-prem preflight checklist.

Looping in Soojin (SE) to confirm bandwidth/ops prep. Soojin — can you take lead on the technical portion if we book Wed 6/9 14:00?

Thanks,

Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Calendly: https://calendly.com/jordan-blake/30
